headlines.title: 业界存年内降准降息预期
headlines.summary: 招联首席经济学家、上海金融与发展实验室执行主任董希淼预计，三季度有望实施降准降息。降息方面，若下半年经济复苏动能边际走弱，不排除适时下调政策利率10个基点至20个基点；但受制于商业银行净息差已处于1.40%左右的历史低位，LPR（贷款市场报价利率）进一步下降空间有限，下降幅度或在5个基点至10个基点。降准方面，为配合财政债券集中发行、保持银行体系流动性合理充裕，年内仍有25个基点至50个基点的降准空间，实施的窗口可能安排在债券供给高峰或流动性偏紧时段。此外，中国人民银行将更多运用结构性货币政策工具，加强对市场流动性的适时调节，并加大对科技创新、消费、中小

headlines.title_en: Market expects RRR cut and rate cut within the year
headlines.summary_en: Dong Ximiao, chief economist at UnionPay and executive director of the Shanghai Finance and Development Laboratory, expects rate cuts and RRR cuts to be implemented in Q3. On rate cuts, if economic recovery momentum weakens marginally in H2, a timely cut of policy rates by 10 to 20 basis points cannot be ruled out; however, constrained by commercial banks' net interest margins at a historical low of around 1.40%, the room for further LPR declines is limited, with reductions likely between 5 and 10 basis points. On RRR cuts, to support concentrated government bond issuance and maintain reasonable liquidity in the banking system, there remains room for a 25 to 50 basis point cut within the year, with the implementation window likely scheduled during peak bond supply or tight liquidity periods. Additionally, the PBOC will increase the use of structural monetary policy tools to strengthen timely liquidity adjustment and boost support for tech innovation, consumption, and SMEs.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：非制造业商务活动指数有所下降，文旅行业较为活跃
headlines.summary: 国家统计局服务业调查中心首席统计师霍丽慧表示，7月份，非制造业商务活动指数为49.0%，比上月下降1.2个百分点，非制造业景气水平较上月回落。文旅行业景气回升。服务业商务活动指数为49.3%，比上月下降1.1个百分点，服务业市场活跃度有所回落。从行业看，在暑期消费带动下，居民休闲娱乐和旅游出行有所增加，航空运输、住宿、文化体育娱乐等行业商务活动指数较上月明显回升，相关企业业务总量增长较快；批发、货币金融服务等行业商务活动指数下降幅度较大，是本月服务业景气度回落的主要因素；资本市场服务、房地产等行业商务活动指数低于临界点。服务业业务活动预期指数为56.0%

headlines.title_en: NBS: Non-manufacturing business activity index declines, cultural and tourism sectors remain active
headlines.summary_en: Huo Lihui, chief statistician at the NBS Service Industry Survey Center, stated that in July, the non-manufacturing business activity index was 49.0%, down 1.2 percentage points from the previous month, with the non-manufacturing prosperity level declining. The cultural tourism industry saw a rebound in prosperity. The services business activity index was 49.3%, down 1.1 percentage points from the previous month, with service market activity declining. By industry, driven by summer consumption, residents' leisure entertainment and travel increased, and the business activity indices for air transport, accommodation, and culture, sports and entertainment rose significantly from the previous month, with related enterprises seeing rapid growth in total business volume; the business activity indices for wholesale and monetary financial services fell sharply, being the main factors in this month's service prosperity decline; capital market services and real estate industries had business activity indices below the threshold. The expected index for service industry business activity was 56.0%

headlines.title_en: NBS: July manufacturing PMI at 49.2%, down 1.1 percentage points from previous month
headlines.summary_en: According to the National Bureau of Statistics, in July, the manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) was 49.2%, down 1.1 percentage points from the previous month, with the prosperity level declining. The non-manufacturing business activity index was 49.0%, down 1.2 percentage points from the previous month, with the non-manufacturing prosperity level falling. The composite PMI output index was 49.3%, down 1.3 percentage points from the previous month, indicating that the production and operation activities of Chinese enterprises slowed compared to the previous month.

headlines.summary_en: PBOC open market operations: conducted 134 billion yuan of 7-day reverse repos at an operation rate of 1.40%, unchanged from last time. headlines.title: 政治局会议深读｜十大券商：政策更加积极，稳市力度有望增加
headlines.summary: 招联首席经济学家、上海金融与发展实验室执行主任董希淼预计，三季度有望实施降准降息。降息方面，若下半年经济复苏动能边际走弱，不排除适时下调政策利率10个基点至20个基点；但受制于商业银行净息差已处于1.40%左右的历史低位，LPR（贷款市场报价利率）进一步下降空间有限，下降幅度或在5个基点至10个基点。降准方面，为配合财政债券集中发行、保持银行体系流动性合理充裕，年内仍有25个基点至50个基点的降准空间，实施的窗口可能安排在债券供给高峰或流动性偏紧时段。此外，中国人民银行将更多运用结构性货币政策工具，加强对市场流动性的适时调节，并加大对科技创新、消费、中小

headlines.summary: 据同花顺iFinD数据，沪深京三市成交额超1万亿元，较上日此时放量2990亿元，预计全天成交金额约3.1万亿元。截至目前，沪市成交额4631亿元，深市成交额5314亿元，北证50成交额71亿元。

headlines.title_en: Total trading volume across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets exceeds 1 trillion yuan, up 299 billion yuan from the same time yesterday.
headlines.summary_en: According to Hithink Flush iFinD data, trading volume across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets exceeded 1 trillion yuan, up 299 billion yuan from the same time the previous day, with full-day turnover estimated at around 3.1 trillion yuan. So far, Shanghai market turnover was 463.1 billion yuan, Shenzhen market was 531.4 billion yuan, and Beijing Stock Exchange 50 was 7.1 billion yuan.
